strategies.name: BLOCK_RISKY_ACTION
strategies.guidance: Do not create_playlist or add_song yet. First gather the full required track set with show_song_library / recommendations as specified by the task, print song_ids, then create the playlist and add only those ids.

strategies.name: VERIFY_TARGET_SET
strategies.guidance: Before creating a playlist or adding songs, print the exact song_id set required by the task. Create/add only after the set is complete and matches the constraints.

strategies.name: REPLAN
strategies.guidance: Abandon early playlist writes. Re-plan: login Spotify if needed -> collect required tracks -> print ids -> create_playlist -> add only those songs -> verify playlist contents.

strategies.name: LOOKUP_API_SPEC
strategies.guidance: Before create_playlist/add_song, call show_api_doc for the Spotify playlist and library APIs you will use. Confirm parameters, then proceed.
